mapper.select: SELECT * FROM kb_knowledge_base WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_time DESC
SELECT * FROM kb_knowledge_base WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_knowledge_base (name, description, doc_count, deleted, creator_id, created_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, 0, 0, #{creatorId}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_knowledge_base SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE kb_knowledge_base SET doc_count = doc_count + #{count}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE kb_knowledge_base SET doc_count = GREATEST(doc_count - #{count}, 0), updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
